verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented documentation is a fair question for an analytics SaaS with developer docs, so the axis applies. The probe found llms.txt returns HTTP 404, and no agent-oriented docs are evidenced. The official MCP server and the Data/Admin APIs belong to other stories and do not count as agent-readable documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
